overview_description.description: Cashmere creates a safer crypto wallet that secures treasury. It transfers funds using the multi-signature signing feature, which combines the flexibility of hot wallets with the storage security of cold wallets. Cashmere focuses on assisting people in securely storing their cryptocurrency. It will safeguard cryptocurrencies even if hot wallets such as Slope and Phantom are compromised.
